acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Each dimension has a numeric input field with valid range 5-100 cm, increment/decrement buttons (+/-), unit label displays "cm"
Values outside 5-100 cm show inline error message. Error state: red border + error message below field. Validation occurs onBlur and onChange.
Warning indicator when value is at min (5) or max (100). Subtle amber border when at boundary.
Dimension changes update the 3D cube within 500ms (NFR3). Debounce input to prevent excessive re-renders (100ms). 3D cube scales proportionally.
Dimension values display in monospace font (JetBrains Mono). Labels use body font (Inter). Clear visual hierarchy: label → input → unit.
Tab navigation between dimension fields. Arrow keys increment/decrement values (±1 cm). Shift+Arrow for larger increments (±10 cm). Focus state clearly visible (gold ring on dark theme).
Touch-friendly increment/decrement buttons (44x44px minimum). Input fields are easily tappable. Numeric keyboard appears on mobile devices.
Uses setWidth, setHeight, setDepth actions from configStore. Uses useDimensions selector for current values. Changes trigger recalculation of weight and price.

package.name: use-debounce
package.note: May need to install for debouncing

constraints.constraint: Follow component pattern: hooks first, derived state, event handlers, render. Use Zod for validation schemas. Connect via Zustand selectors for minimal re-renders.
Nero Marquina dark theme in configurator. JetBrains Mono for dimension values. Inter for labels. Gold accent (#C9A962) for focus states.
Dimension changes must reflect in 3D view within 500ms. Use 100ms debounce to prevent excessive updates.
Controls.tsx uses SCALE_FACTOR = 0.02. Zoom limits are dynamic based on dimensions. CubeViewer geometry updates automatically via Zustand state.
MIN_DIMENSION = 5cm, MAX_DIMENSION = 100cm. Values outside range must show error. At boundary shows warning.

learnings.learning: Controls.tsx created with dynamic zoom limits using SCALE_FACTOR = 0.02. minDistance = scaledMax * 1.5, maxDistance = scaledMax * 5. CubeViewer uses frameloop="demand" - OrbitControls handles invalidation.
InteractionHint component created in src/components/configurator/InteractionHint.tsx with localStorage persistence for first-time user hints.
Store already has setWidth, setHeight, setDepth actions that clamp values and trigger calculateDerivedValues. No need to re-implement clamping.
useDimensions selector returns {width, height, depth} for optimized re-renders. useConfigActions returns all action methods.
